---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure
labels: bug
---

## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

Include the commit, OS, Bun or compiler version, command, and a minimal input.
Remove all credentials and sensitive account information.

## Evidence

Include the error and relevant logs. State whether this was offline, a public
API request, a dry run, or live execution.
